name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Pakistan–Afghan Taliban border clashes continue; talks stalled
state: Afghan forces fired on Pakistani posts and homes in Angoor Adda on 27 Oct, killing one resident, after clashes in Kurram and Paktika (Pakistan Today, 1 Nov). Pakistan said on 31 Oct that Taliban-linked terrorism is the main obstacle to normal relations and reserved the right to act; mediation by Qatar, Türkiye and China has stalled.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Afghanistan and to Pakistan's border areas.

sources.title: Pakistan Today — Pakistan slams Afghan Taliban over cross-border terrorism
